title: Must do
text: Suzanna was fantastic!  The tour is from 2-6 pm.  We were the only 2 on tour (we finished early) and we asked Suzanna about Casa Vicens, although it was not part of this tour she accompanied us on metro (we had hola Barcelona passes) and took the tour with us!  It wasn’t busy and we paid 20 euros each for access in addition to cost of booked tour.
author: Jennifer_C

title: Tour guide Angela
text: Our guide Angela was terrific. She was not only knowledgeable but extremely enthusiastic about the places we visited and Guadi. Very attentive to our teenage granddaughter traveling with us
author: ALBERT_F

title: Suzanna was wonderful! A delightful...
text: Suzanna was wonderful! A delightful 4 hours went by so quickly! Susanna is a wealth of information and a delight! Her operatic songs and deligtful banter made this tour super special! I would highly recommend this tour with Suzanna to everyone who visits Barcelona! A delightful way to see Gaudi through the eyes of an appreciative guide! Dr. and Mrs. Jayanty
author: Teresa J
